description: Replace the tuicr skill's herdr wrapper (split pane + pane wait-output) with one that opens tuicr in a herdr popup. herdr exposes popups to the CLI only through plugin panes (placement = popup), so: ship a local herdr plugin (manifest + popup-side script), add programs.herdr.plugins to link plugin roots at activation (herdr keeps its registry in plugins.json, not config.toml), and patch the toolbox tuicr-skills bundle so SKILL.md and tuicr-wrapper-herdr.sh use the popup.
title: tuicr in a herdr popup via a nix-managed herdr plugin
